title: Preloaded Geometric Tokenization
subtitle: The Axiom of 1 as Preloaded Unity Generating Binary Sequence, Nested Counts, and a 4D Inverse Operational Encoding with the Master Table as Fixed Vocabulary
organization: Future Caribbean AI, Team AMOC Sentienl
introductory_note: This paper reframes the mechanical counting system as preloaded geometric tokenization. The single axiom of unity (1) is treated as the preloaded starting token. The first operation produces 2 of 1 and initiates the binary sequence. All subsequent structure — the Master Table, compounding operations, and counts inside counts — follows deterministically from this preloaded unity. The token is both an address and a value, both machined from the one inverse operational mechanical count. The coordinate system is preloaded; data mapping is external.

new_in_v0_3: Count 5 remains the structural 4D closure of the primary cycle (xyzw).
For computation and tokenization, the count is indefinitely repeatable.
Counts c = 6, 7, 8, ... are not new operations but continued inward refinement at finer scale.
Base tokens live at c = 5 (512 slots, 9 bits) for efficient offline storage.
Refinement is machined on demand by appending counted bits to the same progressive bitstream.
The overlay layer for physical data read on the coordinate includes gas and thermal overlays implemented and validated.

axiom_of_preloaded_unity.axiom: There is exactly one physical unit.
axiom_of_preloaded_unity.definition: The number 1 is preloaded unity. It is not generated; it is the shared foundation present before any counting begins.
axiom_of_preloaded_unity.role: The axiom is both the largest entity and the smallest indivisible token in the system.

count_direction_and_mechanic.claim_1: sqrt(2) is the metric of the inward count.

outward_counting.meaning: Mechanical Domain Quantity; counts whole units outward.

inward_counting.meaning: The inward direction measured from the inside by geometric halving.

count_direction_and_mechanic.claim_2: The count and the depth come apart.
count_direction_and_mechanic.depth_definition: Depth d is the honest exponent and advances once per halving.
count_direction_and_mechanic.count_definition: Count c is the operation index and advances only when the depth completes a rational-irrational pair.

address_span.note: Generated internally from the Master Table, not imported as an external constant.

birth_of_binary_sequence.meaning: This is the first distinction, first split, and first bit. It is the mechanical birth of binary.
birth_of_binary_sequence.consequence: Every subsequent count compounds upon this binary foundation.

compounding_operations.principle: Each new count is a compounding operation built directly upon the output of the prior count.

indefinite_inverse_counting.meaning: Count 5 closes the primary 4D cycle but does not terminate computation or tokenization.
indefinite_inverse_counting.continued_counts: Counts c=6,7,8,... continue the same inward mechanic at finer scale.

on_demand_refinement.description: Higher resolution is obtained by refining the same point on a finer grid, not by introducing a different system.
on_demand_refinement.mechanic: Refinement appends counted bits to the same progressive bitstream.
on_demand_refinement.principle: The spans do not change; the grid does.
operational_options: append refinement bits only when higher precision is requested

address_and_value_model.address: signed count-position on the 720 dual span and the 512 vector
address_and_value_model.value: the 4D inverse-wavefunction state read off the master count, raised dimension by dimension through inversion of the one axiom about its 0 center
address_and_value_model.principle: Both address and value are machined from the same inverse operational mechanical count.

overlay_layer.description: Physical data is read on the preloaded coordinate system rather than changing the coordinate itself.
overlay_layer.status_note: The coordinate system is preloaded; data mapping is external.

fit: offline AI token storage at a fixed base vocabulary
